Implemented Go selection, discovery, lifecycle integration, regressions, and documentation.

A regression with correctly declared child inputs passes. Fixing the ratified fixture requires authorization outside this scope; I preserved dependency admission.

The merger must record the selection/discovery decision before the next issue.
